description: Reusing an Idempotency-Key with a DIFFERENT request (different input) returns 409 idempotency_key_conflict; the original response is not modified.

environment.database: sqlite at OOMOL_CONNECT_DATA_DIR=/tmp/oc-t01-data-a (throwaway, deleted after probes)
environment.runtime_auth: stored oct_ runtime tokens minted via POST /api/runtime-tokens
environment.node: host Node v26.7.0 running pinned sources via native TS execution; image probes use node:24-alpine build

setup: first call: arxiv.get_paper input {id:2301.00001} with key oc-t01-replay2-* (the key_replay fixture call)

response.message: Idempotency-Key has already been used with a different request.

assertions: HTTP 409, errorCode idempotency_key_conflict, message 'Idempotency-Key has already been used with a different request.'

corroborated upstream: 'rejects idempotency keys reused for another input, connection, or action' and 'returns an idempotency conflict when different stored tokens reuse one key' (connect-server.test.ts:2858, 2049)
